paragraphs.text: Skrull is a creature type introduced for Marvel Super Heroes . It is used to represent an alien race of extraterrestrial shapeshifters from the Marvel Universe .

Skrull is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. Skrulls are green-skinned reptilian humanoids with large pointed ears, red or green eyes, and chins with several vertical folds in the skin below their mouths. The Skrulls are known for their physical malleability and ability to shapeshift to any size, shape, or color at will, taking on the appearance but not the characteristics of other beings and objects. Skrulls are able to assume virtually any form, be it organic or inorganic.
They hold a large empire and have often warred against the Kree Empire.
